description: 兵对兵④：主动突破 — 白王主动绕侧翼，迫使黑方让步

intro.popup_en: The white king is on f3 with a pawn on e5 against a black pawn on e6. The black king is far away on b8, so White can go around the pawn blockade and break through from the side.
intro.popup: 💡 主动突破：白王 f3，兵 e5 对黑兵 e6。黑王远在 b8。白方可以绕过兵的对峙，从侧翼强行突破！

outro.popup_en: White wins. The black king is too far away to help. The white king goes around the flank, takes the opposition, and leaves the black pawn undefended.
outro.popup: ✅ 结论：白胜！ 黑王太远，无法及时支援。白王绕侧翼取得对立位后，黑兵无法防守。

moves.popup_en: 1. Ke4: the white king enters the center and prepares to go around the blockade.
moves.popup: 1.Ke4 — 白王进入中心，准备绕行。

moves.popup_en: 1...Kc7: the black king rushes back, but has a long way to go.
moves.popup: 1...Kc7 — 黑王急忙赶回，但路途遥远。

moves.popup_en: 2. Kd4: the white king approaches the d-file and circles around the pawns.
moves.popup: 2.Kd4 — 白王向 d 线靠拢，从侧翼包抄。

moves.popup_en: 2...Kd7: the black king tries to get closer but is already behind.
moves.popup: 2...Kd7 — 黑王努力接近，但已经落后。

moves.popup_en: 3. Kc5: the white king reaches c5 and takes the opposition.
moves.popup: 3.Kc5 — 白王抵达 c5，占据对立位！
